name: interfaces and generics
code: interface Item { value: number }; function first<T>(items: T[]): T { return items[0]; } const items: Item[] = [{value: 7}]; return first(items).value;

name: assertions and satisfies
code: type Item = { value: string }; const item = {value:'yes'} satisfies Item; const maybe: Item | null = item; return (maybe! as Item).value;

name: enums
code: enum Status { Pending, Ready = 3 }; enum Label { Good = 'good' }; return [Status.Ready, Status[0], Label.Good];

name: const enums
code: const enum Bits { Read = 1, Write = 2 }; return Bits.Read | Bits.Write;

name: parameter properties
code: class Item { constructor(public name: string, private count: number) {} total(): number { return this.count; } }; const item = new Item('test', 4); return [item.name, item.total()];

name: type annotations do not check types
timer arguments
code: return await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout((a,b) => resolve(a+b), 5, 2, 3));

name: cleared timer
code: let changed = false; const id = setTimeout(() => changed = true, 1); clearTimeout(id); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5)); return changed;

name: interval
code: return await new Promise(resolve => { let n = 0; const id = setInterval(() => { if (++n === 3) { clearInterval(id); resolve(n); } }, 1); });

name: URL relative and query
code: const u = new URL('../a?x=1#f', 'https://example.com/b/c'); u.searchParams.append('x','two words'); return [u.href, u.origin, u.pathname, u.searchParams.getAll('x')];

name: URL setters and live params
code: const u = new URL('https://example.com:443/path'); const params = u.searchParams; u.search = '?b=2&a=1&a=3'; params.sort(); params.delete('a','1'); u.hostname = 'other.example'; u.port = '8080'; u.hash = 'hello world'; return [u.href, [...params], URL.canParse('no'), URL.parse('no')];

name: query encoding
code: const p = new URLSearchParams([['x','a b'],['x','+'],['z','😀']]); return [p.toString(), p.size, p.has('x','+'), [...p.keys()]];

name: encodeInto boundaries
code: const e = new TextEncoder(); const a = new Uint8Array(3); const b = new Uint8Array(5); return [e.encodeInto('😀', a), [...a], e.encodeInto('A😀B', b), [...b], e.encoding];
